ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% high-intensity (white) to 35% low-intensity (black) across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions occupy the outer lateral sections of both lobes. A central high-density black pigment zone originates at the peduncle and widens toward the median notch, forming a symmetrical anchor shape. Fine black stippling and mottling are concentrated along the proximal leading edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate 50-degree internal angle; notch depth is roughly 15% of total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present across the entire trailing edge boundary, with increased irregularity and small jagged peaks localized near the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave curvature along the trailing edge extending from the median notch to the outer tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed cluster of raised, circular, high-contrast white/grey calcified structures (barnacles) located on the distal trailing tip of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, distinct dark linear stroke roughly 15 pixels wide originating from the trailing edge and extending diagonally into the white field of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant barnacle colonization on the leftmost distal fluke tip; minor irregular tearing or notches on the trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A specific isolated black pixel cluster (spot) located in the lower-central white field of the left lobe, disconnected from the main black pigment body.
